shouldFix.title: Unchanged G16-14 turns the documentation-only DEF-ROLE-NON-TS sentinel back into a required outside-FDB cell
shouldFix.counterexample: Construct the closed domain exactly as coverageLaw now requires: fixtureDomainBasis plus the one deferredSlots entry that actually adds a cell, DEF-WIN. DEF-ROLE-NON-TS expressly contributes no cell and is not a result target; concrete Rust-or-other role cells stay in the FDB and receive fdbRoleResultRule. Now enforce G16-14: it says 'deferredSlots are additional named cells outside that digest' and coverageLaw requires a result 'for each'. Because DEF-ROLE-NON-TS remains physically and semantically under deferredSlots, G16-14 requires a second outside-FDB result for it. Emitting that result violates the newly closed domain and NOT-A-CELL standing; omitting it violates G16-14. No single result map satisfies both laws.
